def outer(value):
 def invoke(target,values):
  local=value+1
  result=target(*values,key=local)
  return result,locals()['local']
 return invoke
def sink(*args,**kw): return args,kw
print(outer(3)(sink,[1,2]))

def sink(*args,**kw): return args,kw
def run():
 yield sink(*(yield 'values'),**(yield 'keywords'))
g=run()
print(next(g),g.send([1,2]),g.send({'end':3}))

 value=7
 return locals(*[])['value']
print(inspect())
